baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verbal noun تَنزِيلٌ (ن ز ل) is sourced through مِن in the paired رَّحْمَٰنِ رَّحِيمِ (ر ح م).
baseline_models.mechanism: Something is caused to descend and reach a recipient, while the source construction makes tenderness and beneficence govern the transfer.

activation_trace.role: Caused descent and conveyance supply the transfer rather than an unmediated appearance.
Tender care and beneficence characterize the named source and therefore the delivered act.

changed_reading.after: A deliberately conveyed communication arrives as an act whose source and governing quality are mercy.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: تَنزِيلٌ can activate ordered placement, while the doubled mercy names constrain the manner of that placement.
baseline_models.mechanism: Descent can be functional emplacement: putting what is delivered into an appropriate rank, location, or stage. Mercy makes the arrangement fitting rather than arbitrary.

activation_trace.role: Placement in a fitting station turns vertical motion into ordered arrangement.
Merciful care supplies the criterion by which the emplacement is read as fitting.

changed_reading.before: Descent is only movement from above to below.
changed_reading.after: Descent is also the merciful ordering of content into the stations where it can serve its recipients.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ن ز ل inventory includes prepared hospitality, and the ر ح م inventory includes both care and the womb as a protected place of formation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The root pairing permits an exploratory image of an arrival whose landing is already provisioned and sheltered by its source.

activation_trace.role: Prepared provision for an arriving guest supplies a hospitable landing rather than a bare deposit.
The womb supplies a protected generative enclosure, carried here only as an exploratory root image.

changed_reading.before: Delivery deposits content at a destination.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, delivery also prepares a nurturing place and provision for what arrives and for those who receive it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah identifies an assembled written whole whose units are differentiated, gathered for recitation, expressed intelligibly, and exposed to knowledge. Merciful emplacement becomes a coordinated joining-and-separating operation.

activation_trace.role: Fitting emplacement anchors the reading of descent as ordered articulation.
Merciful care makes intelligible arrangement part of the benefaction.
Joining one element to another supplies the assembly of a coherent book.
Detailed division exposes parts and meanings, supplying differentiation within the assembled whole.
Gathering supplies the counter-motion that keeps differentiated units in a recitable whole.
Clear expression makes the ordered content accessible rather than merely arranged.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the intended result of the articulation.

structural_cues: 41:3 continues the focus nominal opening by identifying and internally describing the descending entity.
The sequence moves from source in 41:2 to organization, language, and audience uptake in 41:3.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies joining, detailed partition, gathering, clear expression, and disclosure; I infer that these are coordinated operations of the تَنزِيل, while a live alternative is that they describe the book independently rather than the descent process.

changed_reading.before: Merciful descent places a message before an audience.
changed_reading.after: Merciful descent assembles, differentiates, and voices the message so each part occupies an intelligible place within a coherent whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation sequence stabilizes the earth, fixes growing benefit in it, apportions sustenance, assigns each heaven its command, and guards the result. This enlarges ordered descent into the same kind of measured, sustaining allocation.

activation_trace.role: Fitting placement anchors the analogy between revelation and ordered cosmic allocation.
Beneficent care links arrangement to sustenance rather than bare control.
Firm stabilization supplies a settled base for what is apportioned.
Stable, growing good makes the arrangement productive.
Deliberate estimation supplies the measured allocation.
Life-sustaining provision identifies the practical end of the measure.
Divine communication assigned within each heaven extends revelation into domain-specific ordering.
Guarding preserves the completed arrangement.

structural_cues: 41:9-12 expands from earth-making through measured provision to a command assigned within every heaven.
The repeated language of making, measuring, completing, and guarding forms a staged allocation sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stabilization, growing benefit, measure, sustenance, domain-specific communication, and protection; I infer that this sequence models how merciful emplacement works, while the live alternative is that cosmogenesis is only evidence of the sender's power.

changed_reading.before: The message is put into an appropriate communicative place.
changed_reading.after: Its descent participates in a merciful economy of stabilization, measured provision, assigned function, and preservation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same arrival can function as guidance and healing or be held at distance by protective coverings, auditory weight, barriers, counter-noise, and inner blindness. Mercy provides an accessible remedy without coercively bypassing reception.

activation_trace.role: Conveyance establishes that content reaches the human scene even when uptake fails.
Beneficent care anchors guidance and healing as intended availability rather than forced effect.
A preserving cover becomes a self-described layer insulating the inner recipient.
Weight in hearing supplies an auditory bottleneck.
Prevention of access supplies a relational barrier between speaker and hearers.
Mixed disruptive noise turns failed hearing into an organized counter-channel.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies one realized function of the delivered text.
Cure and restoration supply the remedial function for receptive hearers.
Inner blindness supplies the opposite realized state without changing the delivered object.
Distance converts a present call into one experienced as remote.

structural_cues: 41:4-5 moves from non-hearing to layered claims of enclosure, weight, and separation.
41:26 makes interference deliberate, while 41:44 states the divergent outcomes of guidance-healing and deaf-blind distance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, barriers, deliberate noise, and divergent effects; I infer a reception-gating mechanism, while a live alternative is that these images are verdicts on two groups rather than an account of how delivery is received.

changed_reading.before: A merciful delivery guarantees benefit simply by arriving.
changed_reading.after: Mercy makes guidance and healing available, but descent does not erase agency or force its way through cultivated barriers.

context_deltas.mechanism: A rejected demand for descending angels is reversed when angels actually descend upon steadfast recipients, remove fear and grief, announce good, remain protective allies, and culminate in a نُزُل from a forgiving, merciful source. The focus descent opens an economy of welcome rather than merely transporting text.

activation_trace.role: Prepared provision for an arrival anchors the initially exploratory hospitality model.
Merciful care anchors hospitality in the focus source phrase.
Caused descent supplies the skeptics' requested credential.
Angels identify what the rejecters demand be sent instead of human messengers.
Steady uprightness supplies the recipient posture preceding actual descent.
Actual angelic descent reverses the earlier demand but changes its purpose from proof to accompaniment.
Angels now arrive as consoling attendants rather than substitute messengers.
Joy-opening news supplies the affective effect of the visitation.
Protective friendship extends the descent into continuing companionship.
Prepared guest-provision makes the hospitality branch explicit in the later echo.
Protective covering of fault adds restoration to the welcome.
The repeated merciful source closes the exact hospitality echo back to the focus.

structural_cues: 41:14 demands that angels be sent down, whereas 41:30 grants angelic descent to steadfast recipients for reassurance rather than spectacle.
41:32 repeats the focus pattern of a ن ز ل noun followed by مِن and a merciful source epithet.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the rejected demand, the later actual descent, companionship, and the exact hospitality-source echo; I infer that 41:2 anticipates this economy of welcome, while a live alternative is that the focus remains solely a title for the book's transmission.

changed_reading.before: A text is transferred from a merciful source.
changed_reading.after: The textual descent inaugurates a hospitable visitation: arrival, reassurance, protective companionship, and prepared provision from mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Water is sent down onto a subdued earth, which then moves, swells, and lives. The repeated descent root turns revelation from an inert deposit into an input that activates latent capacities in a receptive ground.

activation_trace.role: Delivered descent anchors the comparison between communication and rain.
Beneficent care supplies the life-giving direction of the comparison.
The same caused descent now delivers water to a dormant recipient.
Water conveyed by pouring supplies the material carrier of activation.
Earth and vegetation stirring into life supplies the first visible response.
Nourished growth supplies expansion after reception.
Earth revived through rain states the completed life-giving effect.

structural_cues: 41:39 gives a causal sequence: descent of water, movement, swelling, and revival.
The earth begins subdued and changes only after receiving what descends.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated descent root and an explicit rain-to-life sequence; I infer an ecological model for revelatory activation, while a live alternative is that the verse is only a resurrection sign and not a model of textual reception.

changed_reading.before: The descending message is valuable content placed before people.
changed_reading.after: Like delivered water, merciful descent can awaken, expand, and vivify capacities that were present but dormant.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later reprise calls the object a strong book, denies falsehood access from either direction, and repeats تَنزِيلٌ مِنْ with wisdom and praiseworthiness as source predicates. Mercy is therefore precise and integrity-preserving, not softness detached from truth.

activation_trace.role: Conveyed descent anchors the exact later reprise.
Merciful beneficence is the focus source quality now tested against later qualities.
An ordered written object identifies the protected form of the delivery.
Strength supplies resistance rather than fragility.
Loss of truth and stability names what cannot penetrate the book.
The repeated descent-from construction formally returns to the focus.
Precision and secure construction supply the delivery's internal integrity.
Being found praiseworthy supplies a fitting end as well as a source quality.

structural_cues: 41:42 repeats the focus's nominal تَنزِيلٌ مِنْ construction with a new pair of source epithets.
The reprise is immediately preceded by a front-and-back exclusion of falsehood.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies structural repetition, resistance to falsehood, precision, and praiseworthiness; I infer that integrity is a mechanism of mercy, while a live alternative is that the two epithet pairs are parallel descriptions without a causal relation.

changed_reading.before: Mercy describes a gentle source for the message.
changed_reading.after: Mercy also arrives as precise, resilient communication whose protected integrity is part of its beneficence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus attributes descent to its merciful source. Later, a person tastes mercy after harm and converts it into 'mine,' then withdraws when given benefit. The source phrase thus works against appropriation: a gift should preserve relation and gratitude rather than become entitlement.

activation_trace.role: Conveyance marks the mercy as received rather than self-originating.
Mercy names the source relation that later possessive speech erases.
Experienced tasting frames both mercy and consequence as received conditions.
The explicit experience of mercy repeats the focus source quality inside the attribution test.
Harm as loss supplies the contrasting condition after which mercy is tasted.
Benefaction supplies a second received good that tests the recipient's orientation.
Moving far away supplies the relational response to benefaction.
Withdrawal to the side makes the distance an enacted separation.

structural_cues: 41:2 says the descent is from the Merciful; 41:50 says mercy is from 'us' and immediately quotes the recipient's 'this is mine.'
41:51 repeats benefaction followed by withdrawal, then reverses withdrawal into expansive petition under harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit source grammar, possessive reclassification, and withdrawal after benefit; I infer that attribution is an ethical function of the focus phrase, while a live alternative is that the later examples indict ingratitude generally without glossing 41:2.

changed_reading.before: From the Merciful is descriptive provenance.
changed_reading.after: The source phrase is also anti-appropriative: receiving mercy should preserve dependence and gratitude instead of converting gift into self-owned entitlement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mercy becomes an enacted social operation: a better counter-action displaces evil and can reorder hostile distance into protective, intimate nearness.

activation_trace.role: Tender beneficence anchors the ethical quality being operationalized.
Close kinship supplies the relational endpoint toward which hostility is transformed.
Doing what is better supplies the active merciful input.
Removing the harmful force supplies the directional action.
Hostility supplies the initial relational state.
Protective friendship supplies the transformed state.
Near kin-like intimacy intensifies the endpoint beyond mere truce.

structural_cues: 41:34 presents a before-and-after relation: enmity becomes intimate protective friendship through the better response.
41:35 says this operation is received only with patience and a great share, so it is demanding rather than sentimental.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beneficent action, repulsion, hostility, friendship, and kin-like nearness; I infer that this is mercy enacted downstream of the merciful descent, while a live alternative is that it is an independent ethical command.

changed_reading.before: The paired mercy names describe the sender's disposition.
changed_reading.after: They also forecast a demanding relational force that can reorder hostility into protective nearness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps womb, pregnancy, plant sheath, and birth branches onto textual formation. It remains anchored in the focus ر ح م womb branch and ن ز ل emplacement, while 41:3 and 41:47 supply explicit packet-backed collection, separation, concealment, carrying, and release. Downstream prose should call it a gestational analogy, not claim that the focus lexically means pregnancy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ر ح م in 41:2 can name a generative enclosure, while تَنزِيلٌ can name staged placement and delivery.

activation_trace.role: The womb supplies the focus-anchored generative container.
Staged emplacement supplies ordered formation and release.
A womb gathering a pregnancy turns recited collection into the first gestational activation.
Separation of an infant from its mother supplies release into distinct units.
Emergence from concealment supplies the transition into visibility.
A plant sheath supplies a second protected container alongside the womb.
Hidden pregnancy or fruit supplies inward carrying before emergence.
Giving birth supplies the final release from protected formation.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, content is gathered and formed under mercy, then separated and brought forth as articulated units.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it depends on the audible proximity of ن ز ل and ن ز غ, not a shared root or etymology. It remains anchored in focus descent and in 41:36's packet-backed incitement branch, with refuge supplying the response. Downstream prose must present it only as a sound-and-sequence contrast between ordered arrival and disruptive intrusion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ordered, merciful تَنزِيلٌ of 41:2 can be heard later against the disruptive نَزْغٌ of 41:36.

activation_trace.role: Putting content into a fitting station supplies the ordered side of the contrast.
Merciful care identifies the relational quality of the ordered arrival.
Incitement that corrupts relations supplies the destabilizing intrusion.
Seeking refuge supplies the boundary that protects reception from the intrusion.

changed_reading.before: Any inwardly arriving impulse might be treated as comparable communication.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the focus marks an ordered merciful arrival that must be distinguished from relation-corrupting verbal incitement.

strongest_changes: The 41:30-32 reversal and exact hospitality-source echo turn descent into reassurance, companionship, and prepared welcome.
The rain sequence at 41:39 makes descent an activating input that revives latent life rather than an inert deposit.
The repeated تَنزِيلٌ مِنْ construction at 41:42 joins mercy to wisdom, praiseworthiness, strength, and resistance to falsehood.
The contrast between source-attributed mercy and the later claim 'this is mine' makes provenance ethically anti-appropriative.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context made the focus roots recur as demanded angelic descent, actual angelic descent, prepared hospitality, life-giving rain, repeated guarded revelation, and experienced mercy; it also reactivated the womb branch through the pregnancy and emergence sequence.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation between the nominal opening in 41:2 and the book description in 41:3 affects how tightly articulation belongs to the descent process.
The gestational and ن ز ل versus ن ز غ readings are contained analogies, not lexical identifications.
Hospitality, rain, and cosmic allocation may be mutually reinforcing models rather than one unified mechanism.
